versions.changelog:
- Questions marked as `done` or `wontfix` must now be immediately moved from `## Active Questions` to `## Completed Questions` in the same edit.
- Added a rule to use only plausible real timestamps; never write a `completedAt` in the future.
- Updated completion criteria: finished entries must be relocated to the completed section, and their completion time must match the actual run.
- Minor clarifications and rule emphasis to improve queue cleanliness and accuracy.

- Initial release of the structured research queue skill.
- Enables capturing, investigating, and tracking open technical and workflow questions.
- Enforces high-quality research workflow with strict status management and evidence requirements.
- Supports web/local investigation tools and bounded experiments.
- Integrates with OpenClaw cron for autonomous background research.
- Clearly distinguishes verified answers, hypotheses, and blocked work.
